analysis.title: GS Milhous - CAS Mark to Market for Thursday 15 Oct 2026
key_insights: US equities rallied off morning lows in a volatile session: SPX +33bps to 7744, NDX -5bps to 29,935, RTY +138bps to 2767. 8 of 11 sectors finished higher.
Sector leaders were Healthcare +1.84%, Materials +1.71%, Financials +1.38%, Consumer Disc. +1.16% and Real Estate +1.00%. Laggards were Energy -1.55%, Tech -0.54% and Utilities -0.21%.
AI headlines and debates continued to dominate risk appetite, with defensive pockets of the market catching a bid. Global Neoclouds (GSXGNEOC) rose 57bps after being down about 10% intraday.
US rates extended the post-CPI rally, led by the belly, which finished 11bps richer. Volumes ran about 150% above recent averages and the flight-to-quality bid continued.

Morning data was hotter on net. Feed-through to PCE led GIR to raise its core PCE forecast by 2bps to 34bps, but the rates market shrugged it off because AI wobbles and the flight-to-quality bid dominated.
Curve moves: 2s10s cash is 6.5bps flatter, 2s30s 6bps flatter and 1y1y is 8bps richer. October meeting pricing implies about 30% odds of a hike and about 29bps of hikes through year-end.
Flows: paying flows kept swap spreads stable even though foreign money managers were better sellers of the complex.
Macro credit finished flat to slightly better after opening notably wider. CDX IG closed flat and CDX HY +13cts. Hyperscaler spreads widened another couple of bps but closed well off the day's wides.
CRWV opened 2pts lower, sold off further, then recovered to close 1-3pts higher on the day after yesterday's rout.
Credit vol stayed relatively stable during the equity volatility, which drove some demand for downside protection. Primary issuance was $2bn in one IG deal and no HY deals.

The Dollar held its losses across G10 as yields fell. EUR +55bps is back on a 1.22 handle, retracing all losses since Friday's close. AUD was the worst performer after weak Australian labor market data.
Many clients stayed on the sidelines and did not chase the Dollar lower after buying USD on yesterday's hot CPI print. USDJPY fell only 15bps despite its beta to yields.
GS says that if growth or financing scares extend, JPY's role as a funding and safe-haven currency, together with USD's AI sensitivity, makes USDJPY downside an efficient hedge.
Upcoming: Warsh's speech late tonight during Asia hours, tier 2 data tomorrow, and the Treasury primary dealer questionnaire.
